title: 鸟为什么会飞
subtitle: 轻、有力，还有一对好翅膀
character: wearing a teal t-shirt, brown shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, soft gouache painting on textured paper, flat rounded shapes with fine brown outlines, palette of warm feather brown, sky blue and cream, gentle brush texture

pages.zh:
一只小鸟停在栏杆上。
我刚走近，
它就拍拍翅膀飞走了。
我也张开胳膊跑，
可是一点也飞不起来。
pages.scene: The little boy stands with both arms spread wide on a path, watching a small bird fly up from a railing in front of him.

pages.zh:
鸟身上盖着「羽毛」。
羽毛中间一根硬轴，
两边是细细的分支，
分支上还有小钩子，
互相钩住，就成了一片。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one feather on a cream background drawn large, with a central shaft and fine barbs on both sides. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
羽毛很轻，
可是拼在一起很结实，
还能挡风、挡雨、保暖。
鸟每天都要用嘴
把羽毛梳整齐。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one bird seen from the side on a cream background with rows of overlapping feathers drawn on its wing and back. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
鸟的骨头是空心的。
里面有细细的支架，
又轻又不容易断。
所以鸟的身体，
比看起来轻得多。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one bone shown in cross-section on a cream background, hollow inside with a few thin struts across it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
翅膀上面是拱起来的，
下面是平的。
空气从上面走的路长，
跑得快，压得轻；
下面压得重，就把翅膀往上托。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one wing cross-section on a cream background with a curved top and flat bottom, air lines passing over and under it, and one arrow pointing up from below. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以鸟往前飞得越快，
翅膀托得越有力。
这个往上托的力，
叫升力。
飞机的翅膀也是这样。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one wing on a cream background with one long arrow pointing forward and one shorter arrow pointing up from the wing. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
往下拍的时候，
羽毛合得严严的，
把空气推下去；
往上抬的时候，
羽毛张开一点，让空气漏过去。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two wings side by side on a cream background: the left one pressing down with feathers closed tight, the right one lifting with small gaps between the feathers. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
拍翅膀要很大的力气。
所以鸟的胸口
有两块很厚的肌肉，
是身上最壮的地方，
专门用来拍翅膀。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one bird seen from the front on a cream background with two thick muscle shapes marked on its chest. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
不同的翅膀会不同的飞法。
又长又窄的会滑翔，
又短又圆的能在树林里转弯，
很尖的能飞得非常快。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three bird wing shapes in a row on a cream background: one long and narrow, one short and rounded, one narrow and pointed. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
大鸟还会借风。
太阳晒热地面，
热空气往上升，
它张着翅膀转圈，
一下一下被托得越来越高。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one large bird on a pale background circling upward inside a wide column of rising arrows. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
也有鸟不会飞。
企鹅的翅膀变成了桨，
在水里游得很快；
鸵鸟太重了，
可是跑得比人快得多。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two birds side by side on a cream background: one penguin with short flipper wings and one ostrich with long legs. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我不再张着胳膊跑了。
我坐在台阶上看那只小鸟。
它拍了三下，
就到了屋顶上。
它的本事，都藏在羽毛和胸口里。
pages.scene: The little boy sits on a step with his chin in his hands, watching a small bird perched on a roof above him.
